activity_summary: Walking home from the Cross Keys under a half moon, you let the play end on the laugh and then refused that ending. A man comes in, in black, from her father's court, says half a line, and she ends it. You tried it three ways, each shorter. They do not marry today. A twelvemonth, earned where you cannot see. You said Heminges will call it no ending, and that it is the only ending. You stopped on a doorstep. The frost was on the pump.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the memo, laughed once without sound, and stopped.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named as the man who will object. Not present.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Black, and each time shorter

facets.activity: Found the messenger and stopped on a doorstep

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A man comes in. Black. From her father's court. He says half a line and she ends it for him.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: And they don't marry. Not today. A twelvemonth. Let them earn it where we can't see.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Heminges will say it's no ending. …It's the only ending.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Remember: the frost on the pump tonight, how breath hangs white in the close.
